result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane intersection in a residential area with significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of pedestrian refuges and the presence of large vehicles create a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main multi-lane roadway in the center of the frame.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large truck parked near the intersection obscures the view between pedestrians and oncoming or turning traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder-style markings to increase the visibility of the pedestrian crossing area.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with a marked zebra crosswalk but no signalization or pedestrian refuge. High traffic volume, including heavy freight vehicles, and long unprotected crossing distances create a high-risk environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unprotected Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge or signal control.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the zebra markings.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large semi-truck is positioned near the crosswalk, creating significant sightline obstructions for both pedestrians and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to provide a safe waiting area and allow for two-stage crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signal that remains dark until activated by a pedestrian, providing a red light to stop traffic.

result.summary: The environment is dominated by high-volume, heavy vehicle traffic with a complete lack of visible pedestrian infrastructure such as crosswalks or signals at a major intersection. The massive scale of the roadway and the presence of large semi-trucks create a hostile and dangerous environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Blind Spots
hazards.description: The presence of a large semi-truck in the middle of the intersection creates significant blind spots for both the truck driver and other motorists regarding pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks or designated pedestrian paths across this wide, high-speed arterial.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway requires a very long unprotected crossing time, increasing exposure to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire width of the visible roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised medians to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait mid-crossing, reducing exposure time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to manage crossing expectations.
